summary: Tenant experiences intermittent model selection flip during weighted-stabilization window
description: Issue summary: Customer reports intermittent switches between the pinned model and fallback variant for a single tenant during a slow, weighted rollout. Impact: Several inference requests return responses from the legacy variant instead of the pinned model for short bursts (~10-30s) causing degraded quality in production for select sessions. Environment: Dedicated pool (BrightForms dedicated reservation) in us-west; control-plane is hosted; rollout was a staged weighted promotion to rw-13b-v2 with a 2% -> 10% -> 25% schedule. Observed at 2026-03-10 18:22-18:45 UTC. Expected: Tenant traffic should remain pinned to the target version for sessions that were anchored/pinned prior to rollout and only new sessions should be routed per weight. Actual: Some pinned sessions see brief model-selection flips to rw-7b-q4 during the stabilization window, then revert back to rw-13b-v2. The behavior correlates with health smoothing and control-plane rebalancing events. See logs and timeline below.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer creates tenant with model pin to redwood-rw-13b-v2 and active sessions
2) Initiate a weighted rollout/promote of rw-13b-v2 across a subset of hosts (2% then 10%) via Console rollout UI
3) Observe session affinity metrics and request traces for tenant_id=bf-2143 during the 2%->10% window
4) Reproduce by issuing steady streaming requests (chat) from two active clients tied to same tenant token
5) Notice intermittent responses labeled 'variant: rw-7b-q4' in the request headers for one of the clients during the stabilization period
logs: 2026-03-10T18:23:12Z router INFO session=bf-2143 request_id=aa3f71 route=tenant-route selected_variant=redwood-rw-7b-q4 reason=fallback_capacity_check
2026-03-10T18:23:13Z edge-proxy WARN session=bf-2143 request_id=aa3f72 conn=stream-1 upstream_reset=true

investigation_notes: Initial triage: Looks like a short-circuit in the selection logic where health smoothing + host rebalance triggered fallback capacity checks leading to ephemeral variant selection for already-pinned sessions.
Hypothesis 1: Affinity token mapping was re-evaluated during host rebalance; stale edge cookie + control-plane host list mismatch led router to consider session as eligible for fallback
Hypothesis 2: A transient prewarm failure on rw-13b-v2 instances caused capacity_check to fail and router to select a lower-memory variant for latency safety
Related PR: traffic-router change in host selection smoothing introduced in PR #492 could change tie-break ordering under rebalance

Replication: Reproduced in a small internal repro by simulating host_rebalance while a pinned session had a long-lived streaming connection. Confirmed that router logic falls back when prewarm flag is false and affinity mapping misses host check.
comments: Support (Aisha Kumar) 2026-03-10: Customer BrightForms reported intermittent quality regressions. They sent example request_ids and timestamps. Put ticket in P1 due to customer SLA.
SRE (Diego Navarro) 2026-03-10: I'm investigating; initial traces show fallback selection coincident with host_rebalance events. Adding control-plane and router teams. Linking PR #492 for context.

Router Eng (Laura Chen) 2026-03-11: Confirmed router evaluates 'capable_hosts' after host_rebalance and health smoothing TTL can cause temporary exclusion. There's an edge-case where pinned session affinity isn't honored if prewarm flag is missing on host manifest.

Customer (BrightForms - Samir Patel) 2026-03-11: We see ~1-2 flips per 10k requests, impact is visible on scoring. Would prefer a mitigation that ensures pinned sessions are never demoted during rollout.

SRE (Diego Navarro) 2026-03-11: Temporary mitigation applied: adjusted health smoothing window down from 30s->10s for BrightForms pool and forced prewarm checks to be lenient for pinned sessions. Monitoring for 1 hour.
Support (Aisha Kumar) 2026-03-12: Customer confirmed a drop in incidents after mitigation; still monitoring. Next steps: Router patch and longer-term runbook update scheduled.
resolution: Workaround applied: short-term config change to health-smoothing window and prewarm leniency for pinned sessions in BrightForms dedicated pool which reduced flips. Root cause: race between host_rebalance notification and control-plane host manifest prewarm flag propagation combined with strict capacity_check in router selection. Permanent fix: traffic-router PR #506 will change selection ordering to consult session-affinity first and treat pinned sessions as exempt from fallback unless host reports explicit oom/unavailable. Deploy plan: canary PR #506 to staging 2026-03-13, gradual promote to prod with telemetry gating; update runbook to include 'pinned-session leniency' toggle for emergency response. Follow-ups: postmortem to be created and linked (CONFLUENCE-OPS-774), add automated alert when pinned-session fallback rate > 0.1% per tenant.
